option_relations.rationale: Leukemia cutis (myeloid sarcoma) is a direct equivalent to the leaf labels, which all refer to the same condition.
Sweet's syndrome (acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis) does not match the leaf labels, which are all related to leukemia cutis.
Sweet syndrome (atypical/neutropenic) does not match the leaf labels, which are all related to leukemia cutis.
Histiocytoid Sweet syndrome does not match the leaf labels, which are all related to leukemia cutis.
